column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Yahweh is clothed, [with] strength he has girded himself” is combined as “has clothed and girded Himself with strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from then” is rendered “from of old.”
Close to the Hebrew; “rivers” is rendered “floods,” and “their pounding” as “their pounding waves.”
The Hebrew calls the breakers of the sea “majestic”; NASB makes them a second comparison, “Than the mighty breakers of the sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “reliable exceedingly” is rendered “fully confirmed,” and “for length of days” as “forevermore.”
